name: EPS Bio Technology Corp.
summary: EPS Bio Technology Corp. manufactures and sells OEM/ODM blood glucose system in Taiwan. It also provides test strip; diabetic self-monitoring blood glucose systems under the EASYMAX and MDT2 BLE name; and wearable, and NFC and Bluetooth connectivity blood glucose monitors. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
